title: GallosOS Contest Directives
description: Validates the shape of GallosOS gallos.toml. Some accepted fields describe planned capabilities and are not consumed by the current runtime; see ROADMAP.md.

website_list.description: Exact hostnames allowed for web traffic in this mode; Event inherits Default when omitted. Use ['*'] for open Default/Event access. Contest uses judge IP filtering and may also accept IP addresses.

items.description: Planned software-module identifier with format '<category>/<package>'. Validation does not mean the module exists or is installed; the current daemon does not consume this field. The NVIDIA driver example is a roadmap item; see docs/HARDWARE_COMPATIBILITY.md § 1.3.

software_list.description: Requested SquashFS module identifiers. The current daemon does not mount or switch modules from this list, and the build does not assemble a module catalog.

name.description: Proposed visible browser bookmark label. Current desktop configuration does not consume profile bookmarks.

url.description: Full URL or local file path.

allow_usb_storage.description: Whether to allow external USB mass-storage devices in Default/Event, defaulting to true when omitted. Contest always denies external storage regardless of this value. The boot-drive event-data workspace is separate.

allow_audio.description: Planned mode-aware audio setting. The current runtime does not apply this field to PipeWire/WirePlumber.

wallpaper.description: URL to remote wallpaper image, 'default' for GallosOS stock wallpaper, or local file path.

wallpaper_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex checksum of the remote wallpaper image. Required when 'wallpaper' is a remote URL.

schedule.description: One or more absolute time windows during which this mode is active, evaluated against the system UTC wall clock. The current runtime does not verify NTP synchronization before evaluating them.

duration_minutes.description: Relative Contest duration in minutes. The timer uses CLOCK_MONOTONIC for automatic-on-boot or manual Contest sessions. The current runtime does not use this duration as an automatic fallback based on NTP synchronization state.

auto_start_on_boot.description: If true, starts the relative Contest timer at state-machine startup, using duration_minutes or the implementation default of 300 minutes when omitted. If false, a duration can be started manually via gallosctl.

announcements.description: Planned broadcast announcements; the current daemon does not process or display this field.

audit_config.description: Planned administrative proctoring and audit settings. The current runtime does not implement these operations; schema defaults below are descriptive metadata only.

enable_screen_capture.description: Planned setting; periodic screenshot capture is not implemented.

screenshot_interval_secs.description: Planned screenshot interval; not consumed by the current runtime.

enable_code_backup.description: Planned setting; automated code backup is not implemented.

backup_interval_secs.description: Planned backup interval; not consumed by the current runtime.

enable_fleet_telemetry.description: Planned setting; fleet telemetry export is not implemented.

enable_keystroke_forensics.description: Planned setting; input-event forensics is not implemented.

id.description: Planned broadcast-message identifier; acknowledgement tracking is not implemented.

timestamp.description: Planned timestamp for a signed clarification message.

priority.description: Planned priority level; modal/banner display is not implemented.

title.description: Headline or subject of the clarification (e.g. 'Clarification: Problem C').

require_ack.description: Planned acknowledgement behavior; not consumed by the current runtime.

printing_config.description: Planned CUPS printing configuration. The current build does not install or apply the described printing subsystem; schema defaults are metadata only.

mode.description: Planned printing deployment architecture: 'hosted', 'external', or 'none'. Not consumed by the current runtime.

enable_mdns_discovery.description: Planned Avahi/mDNS printer-discovery option; not consumed by the current runtime.

enabled.description: Planned legacy compatibility flag; printing is not implemented.

printer_host.description: IP address or hostname of the external CUPS print server (used with mode = 'external').

print_metadata_header.description: Planned metadata-header option; no print filter currently applies it.

max_pages_per_job.description: Planned print-job page limit; not enforced by the current runtime.

broadcast_config.description: Planned signed clarification/announcement subsystem (gallos-broadcast); the current daemon does not open a listener or verify messages.

enabled.description: Planned option; setting this does not open a listener in the current runtime.

broadcast_public_key.description: Planned Ed25519 public verification key for future signed broadcast messages.

browser_policy.description: Fine-grained Chromium/Firefox managed URL policies to lock down paths within allowed domains.

url_blocklist.description: List of URLs or prefixes to block (e.g. 'https://omegaup.com/problem*').

url_allowlist.description: List of URLs or prefixes to explicitly allow, overriding the blocklist.

global.description: Global settings applied regardless of active execution mode.

config_expiration.description: After this datetime, the directives file is considered expired and the system falls back to Default mode.

available_keyboard_layouts.description: Planned list of layouts for a compositor switcher. The current helper does not apply keyboard layouts.

default_keyboard_layout.description: Planned default XKB layout. The current runtime does not apply this value.

enable_event_mode.description: Legacy/planned flag; the current state machine evaluates configured Event windows without consulting this field. Do not rely on it to disable Event mode.

enable_contest_mode.description: Legacy/planned flag; the current state machine evaluates configured Contest windows without consulting this field. Do not rely on it to disable Contest mode.

branding.description: White-label branding metadata for the event organizer.

name.description: Full event or contest name displayed in the desktop banner.

logo_url.description: URL or local path to the organizer's desktop logo image (PNG/SVG).

boot_splash_logo_url.description: URL or local path to the organizer's logo for the Plymouth boot splash screen.

hostname.description: System hostname applied to the workstation for white-labeling (e.g. 'ICPC', 'UAA', 'GALLOS'). Displayed in the terminal prompt as contestant@<hostname>.

show_powered_by_gallos.description: If true, a small 'Powered by GallosOS' watermark is rendered underneath the custom boot splash and desktop branding. Highly recommended to support the open-source project.

recovery.description: Local-only root recovery access (su from the kiosk session). No SSH/network component — see docs/ROOT_ACCESS.md. Only ever read from the local baked-in gallos.toml, never from a remote-fetched one.

root_password_hash.description: A crypt(3)-format password hash for the root account (e.g. generated with `openssl passwd -6`), applied via `chpasswd -e` at every daemon boot/reload. Never put a plaintext password here. Omit this key (or leave it unset) to keep root locked, which is the shipped default.

default.description: Configuration for Default mode — the fallback when no manual override or active Contest/Event trigger is present.

event.description: Configuration for Event mode (training camps, warm-ups, lecture sessions).

contest.description: Organizer policy for Contest mode. Enforcement depends on supported fields and must be verified on a booted image; this mode is not a complete anti-cheat guarantee.

machines.description: Local Organizer machine/team mapping table. The daemon matches MAC addresses on this workstation; it does not query a central server.

mac.description: Network interface MAC address (lowercase, colon-separated). Used as the unique machine identifier.

pc_number.description: Numeric PC index for sorting and display.

room.description: Physical room or lab where this machine is located.

team_name.description: Contest team assigned to this machine.

printing.description: Optional CUPS network printing configuration for contest environments.
